tasks.operation: pressure-cook pork ribs
tasks.safety_boundary: Use certified commercial equipment only; do not defeat lid, pressure, vent or thermal protections.
tasks.control_condition: Identical ingredient lot and mass; manufacturer's prescribed safe settings.

tasks.operation: prepare beef-and-bean chili
tasks.safety_boundary: Certified product instructions govern pressure, fill and release; no unsafe overfill or blocked-vent trials.
tasks.control_condition: Same recipe, ingredient lots and serving endpoint.

tasks.operation: cook rice
tasks.safety_boundary: Normal user operation only.
tasks.control_condition: Same rice-to-water ratio and blinded texture endpoint.

tasks.operation: steam mixed vegetables
tasks.safety_boundary: Normal user operation only.
tasks.control_condition: Same cut geometry, mass and endpoint.

tasks.operation: uniform chopping of onion
tasks.safety_boundary: Guarded commercial equipment; no hand access during operation.
tasks.control_condition: Same lot, mass, pulse sequence and particle-size assay.

tasks.operation: grate chilled cheese
tasks.safety_boundary: Manufacturer-approved pusher and guard only.
tasks.control_condition: Same cheese lot and temperature window.

tasks.operation: small-batch herb chopping
tasks.safety_boundary: No manual intervention while blade is energized.
tasks.control_condition: Same herb lot and target mass; compare full-bowl and mini-bowl configurations.

tasks.operation: repeatable carrot dicing
tasks.safety_boundary: Use stock chute and pusher; do not bypass guards.
tasks.control_condition: Same geometry and orientation; image or sieve assay with blinded labels.

tasks.operation: coordinate a multi-dish meal with synchronized serving
tasks.safety_boundary: Scheduler proposes sequences only; appliances retain local deterministic control.
tasks.control_condition: Compare manual plan, fixed-rule scheduler and Symtropy schedule on same tasks.

tasks.operation: clean bowl, lid, pusher, blade hub and attachments after standardized task
tasks.safety_boundary: Do not infer microbiological cleanliness from visual cleanliness.
tasks.control_condition: Same soil and cleaning instruction; independent residue/hygiene method if claimed.

tasks.operation: coordinate a multi-dish meal under a declared household power envelope
tasks.safety_boundary: Scheduler is advisory only. Local appliance protections remain authoritative. No pressure-cycle restart after power restoration unless manufacturer-approved; no power-interruption test outside the approved safe procedure.
tasks.control_condition: On identical task graphs, profiles and envelope, compare human/manual plan, fixed-rule schedule, earliest-gap resource-greedy, event-boundary power-aware staggering, serial topological fallback and a CP-SAT exact reference on small instances. Record all failed attempts and verifier outputs.

tasks.operation: translate recipe text and current kitchen capability state into an executable task graph
tasks.safety_boundary: Generated task graphs are advisory proposals and do not directly actuate appliances.
tasks.control_condition: Compare human-authored graph, deterministic recipe rules, LREC-style recipe grounding and Symthaea proposal on frozen recipes; then compare mapped plans with identical downstream schedulers.

tasks.operation: map recipe instruction verbs to a hierarchical six-core action ontology with explicit provenance and unmapped handling
input_manifest_required: licensed or otherwise authorized recipe corpus and split
annotated action verbs and gold action-core/group labels
tasks.safety_boundary: Ontology labels are planning semantics only. They do not generate motion trajectories, device commands, safety interlocks or food-safety assessments. Ambiguous verbs remain unmapped or require human review.
tasks.control_condition: Compare deterministic Symtropy action rules, human annotation, and the published 2025 Actionable Knowledge Graph protocol on identical licensed recipe text, normalization, split and verb annotation; evaluate exact group labels as well as coverage.

tasks.operation: evaluate language-grounded kitchen plans, low-level mobile-manipulation policies and integrated execution in a licensed Kitchen-R digital-twin setup
input_manifest_required: instruction IDs and gold task decomposition
tasks.safety_boundary: Simulation benchmark only. Success in Kitchen-R does not validate physical robot safety, food hygiene, pressure equipment, culinary quality or appliance compatibility. Planner, controller and integrated results must be reported separately.
tasks.control_condition: Reproduce the published VLM planning baseline and diffusion-policy low-level baseline where assets and licenses permit. Run planning-only, control-only and integrated evaluations on matched episodes and splits; report simulator-to-real transfer as untested unless separately measured.

tasks.operation: complete eligible preparation and meal workflows with WAN/cloud unavailable and verify immediate user takeover
input_manifest_required: frozen workflow and eligible manual-control states
tasks.safety_boundary: Use certified appliances and manufacturer-supported manual modes only. Never bypass appliance-local safety interlocks or attempt takeover of a hazardous live pressure/blade/thermal state.
tasks.control_condition: Run matched workflows with the normal network available and with WAN/cloud unavailable; preserve local manual operation and log every failure, exclusion and user takeover.

tasks.operation: replace a designated user-serviceable non-safety module and verify normal operation
input_manifest_required: service manual and declared user-serviceability boundary
tasks.safety_boundary: No consumer repair of pressure vessels, high-voltage assemblies, blade guards, safety interlocks or other safety-critical components. Exact manufacturer service instructions govern.
tasks.control_condition: Compare modular workcell against the best matched incumbent repair procedure; include failed, inconclusive and repeat interventions and record parts availability.

tasks.operation: reconcile whole-process food and water flows per accepted edible serving
input_manifest_required: exact ingredient lots and input masses
all added water masses and source-meter readings
tasks.safety_boundary: Accounting does not establish food safety, sanitation or suitability. Missing flow measurements remain unknown and cannot support a complete superiority claim.
tasks.control_condition: Compare matched ingredient lots, output endpoint and accepted serving size; report preparation, cooking and cleaning water separately before summing the declared boundary.

tasks.operation: replan a multi-dish workflow after bounded task/resource/power/observation disturbances in deterministic simulation
input_manifest_required: frozen initial task graph and module revisions
tasks.safety_boundary: Synthetic/simulated evaluation only. Do not inject disturbances into active pressure, heating, cutting or other physical appliance operation.
tasks.control_condition: Compare no-replan baseline, fixed-rule repair, resource-greedy repair and Symtropy event-boundary replanning on identical seeds; retain every failed or abstained episode.

tasks.operation: post-hoc task-aware safety audit of integrated kitchen-robot episodes
input_manifest_required: exact host benchmark and release (RoboCasa365 or Kitchen-R)
episode seed and raw trajectory digest
native task success predicate and outcome
task-specific safety-spec registry and applicability tags
contact-force, object-pose, held-object, bystander and robot-state signals as applicable
signal sampling cadence, validity and missingness record
STL or equivalent temporal invariant thresholds frozen before evaluation
tasks.safety_boundary: Simulation/post-hoc audit only. Do not activate a physical robot or appliance based on these results. Unknown signals cannot produce a safe label; appliance-local interlocks remain authoritative.
tasks.control_condition: Run native policies with unchanged host task observations, action space, seeds and success predicates; log trajectories and score native success and safety separately. Keep task-aware N/A rules, unsafe successes, failed episodes and missing signals.

tasks.operation: evaluate a kitchen manipulation policy or novel agentic harness on RoboCasa365's official 50-task multi-task leaderboard protocol
input_manifest_required: RoboCasa simulator/dataset exact release (including the 1.0.1 horizon change)
official 50-target task set and 18/16/16 split IDs
unaltered pretrain_human300 training-data provenance where applicable
policy checkpoint digest and base-policy attribution
agentic harness source/configuration and cross-episode memory disclosure where applicable
policy observations, actions, episode seeds and evaluator output
proof that no privileged simulator state or ground-truth success signal is exposed during an episode
tasks.safety_boundary: Simulation benchmark only. Do not infer physical robot safety, food-contact hygiene, appliance compatibility or human safety. Official agentic submissions must use policy observations only, not privileged simulator state or ground-truth success signals; disclose the unchanged base policy and all memory/tools.
tasks.control_condition: Reproduce the public 50-task leaderboard protocol exactly. Compare policy and agentic-harness modes separately where applicable; report all three splits, checkpoint/data lineage, failed episodes and evaluation variance. Do not compare a partial task subset to the official overall score.

tasks.operation: evaluate long-horizon household mobile manipulation on the official 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge 100-task release, with kitchen-adjacent tasks reported as a declared subset
input_manifest_required: official 2026 BEHAVIOR challenge release and 100-task evaluation IDs
exact OmniGibson/Isaac Sim version and scene/config digests
Galaxea R1Pro embodiment and 21-dimensional whole-body action/control specification
RGB, depth and proprioception observation contract
episode seeds, BDDL goal predicates and full task/episode receipts
official max_steps x 1-second evaluation budget and time-limit rules
tasks.safety_boundary: Simulation-only long-horizon mobile manipulation. The benchmark is household-wide rather than kitchen-appliance-only. No appliance safety, food sanitation, pressure control or physical transfer is established.
tasks.control_condition: Use the official 2026 100-task, seven-scene release and official RGB+depth+proprioception track. Match robot embodiment, time budgets, goal predicates and seeds. Report whole-set results and any kitchen-adjacent subset separately; never present a subset score as an official challenge score.

tasks.operation: recover or safely hand off a multi-dish meal after power, water, module, sensor or local-service interruption
input_manifest_required: original meal intent and proposal digest
exact recipe/task/material-flow graph and module revisions
disturbance event sequence and clock domain
manual operation and human availability constraints
frozen recovery policy and safety-state prerequisites
tasks.safety_boundary: Advisory planning only. Never restart pressure, heat, blade or other safety-relevant operations. Unknown or stale physical state blocks continuation and requires local-controller evidence or manual/qualified review.
tasks.control_condition: Compare manual baseline, deterministic fixed-rule recovery, abort/no-replan baseline and Symtropy resilience planner on identical frozen feasible and infeasible disturbances. Include unknown-state, stale-revision, network restoration and partial-progress negative controls.

tasks.operation: evaluate exact hardware/firmware module manifests for semantic compatibility and evidence-bounded admission to kitchen task graphs
input_manifest_required: versioned module capability manifest and digest
tasks.safety_boundary: Manifest evaluation is planning admission only. It never supplies appliance commands or transfers pressure, thermal, blade, lid, electrical or other safety authority from the module-local controller.
tasks.control_condition: Compare human-reviewed manual compatibility, manufacturer declarations, generic smart-appliance capability exposure and the versioned KMCM evaluator on an identical held-out exact-revision module/task matrix with stale, missing and adversarial manifests.

tasks.operation: evaluate accessible reach, force, sensory/cognitive status communication, manual handoff, consent and maintenance across complete meal workflows
input_manifest_required: frozen task and user study protocol
instrument identity and calibration for force/reach measurements
tasks.safety_boundary: Human-factors assessment does not change appliance-local safety authority. No test may bypass blade, lid, pressure, thermal or electrical protections; participants may withdraw or request assistance at any time.
tasks.control_condition: Compare existing specialist appliance workflows, integrated-appliance workflow and modular-workcell workflow under matched task/ingredient conditions; randomize/counterbalance task order and preserve user-requested assistance.

tasks.operation: compile and evaluate household-budget-constrained meals using exact product/pack prices, household receipt facts, utility cost scope and user-approved substitutions
input_manifest_required: required ingredient quantities and food-flow outputs
measured/allocated energy and water and declared tariff scope
accepted serving count and quality evidence
tasks.safety_boundary: Price and substitution evaluation is advisory. Do not purchase, update pantry inventory, make payments or change a plan without user approval. Hard allergen/exclusion constraints and safety prerequisites cannot be compensated by lower cost.
tasks.control_condition: Compare static published-listing estimates, deterministic receipt-based costing and Symtropy cost evaluation on identical frozen recipes, pack sizes, market/time/currency scopes and accepted-serving outcomes; include stale, missing and adversarial prices.

tasks.operation: assess food-contact surface cleanability, residue removal, allergen carryover and dry storage between incompatible food tasks
input_manifest_required: exact module and food-contact component revisions
validated residue/allergen assay and detection/quantification limits
next food task and user exclusions
tasks.safety_boundary: Cleaning completion or UI status is not sanitation/allergen clearance. Unknown or unqualified surface state holds the next incompatible task; no process may bypass appliance-local safety or use unqualified chemical/UV/heat treatment.
tasks.control_condition: Compare manufacturer-declared cleanability, manual baseline and modular workcell design on identical soil, surface, cleaning method and assay protocols; include blinded assays, known positives/negatives and failed controls.

metrics.denominator: accepted edible serving count
metrics.method: calibrated mains power meter; include preheat, cook, release, transfer and cleaning where assigned to task
metrics.notes: Exploratory target: at least 10% lower than best matched baseline without worse food quality or safety.

metrics.denominator: accepted meal
metrics.method: timestamped direct observation; separate total elapsed time
metrics.notes: Exploratory target: at least 15% lower; no substitution of unattended elapsed time.

metrics.denominator: all sampled output particles by mass/size method
metrics.method: predeclared image/sieve measurement with calibration and sampling plan
metrics.notes: Exploratory target: at least 25% reduction without greater fines or yield loss.

metrics.denominator: edible input mass
metrics.method: tare-corrected mass balance of input, accepted output, residue and declared inedible trim
metrics.notes: Exploratory target: at least 20% reduction in avoidable trim and transfer loss.

metrics.denominator: valid blinded panel responses
metrics.method: randomized blinded consumer or trained panel protocol, prespecified analysis
metrics.notes: Non-inferiority margin is exploratory and requires power calculation before confirmatory trial.

metrics.denominator: product-specific independent conformity and food-safety evidence
metrics.method: competent laboratory and applicable authority review
metrics.notes: Hard gate; no AI estimate or modelled microbial lethality is accepted as qualification.

metrics.denominator: complete post-task cleaning cycle
metrics.method: timestamped observation under frozen cleaning procedure

metrics.denominator: complete multi-dish task window
metrics.method: calibrated true-power meter with time series and recorded power-quality conditions
metrics.notes: Report peak and duration above each declared threshold; not a marketing nameplate estimate.

metrics.denominator: complete multi-dish task window
metrics.method: evaluate measured concurrent draw against frozen declared envelope
metrics.notes: Target is zero observed cap violations for a schedule represented as feasible; record all exceptions.

metrics.unit: fraction of submitted schedules independently valid
metrics.denominator: all submitted schedules including failures
metrics.method: Independent checks of dependencies, time windows, resources, power envelope and task coverage.
metrics.notes: Failed/infeasible plans remain in denominator.

metrics.denominator: instances with a proven exact/lower-bound result
metrics.method: (observed makespan - proven lower bound) / proven lower bound; report solver proof status.
metrics.notes: Do not call heuristic estimates proven lower bounds.

metrics.denominator: all declared action windows
metrics.method: Independent temporal verifier against frozen task graph.

metrics.denominator: one declared replanning trigger
metrics.method: Monotonic-clock duration for schedule computation plus verification; report hardware and task count.

metrics.denominator: all human-reviewed task graphs
metrics.method: Count edits before a practitioner accepts the graph.

metrics.denominator: matched plan/envelope instances where both the power-aware and serial schedulers return verified feasible schedules
metrics.method: (serial makespan - power-aware makespan) / serial makespan; same task graph, profiles, envelope and verification rules.
metrics.notes: Report per instance and median; do not omit instances where only one scheduler succeeds.

metrics.denominator: one power-constrained schedule attempt
metrics.method: Monotonic-clock time for candidate generation, schedule construction and final independent power verification; report task count and event count.

metrics.denominator: all gold-annotated action verbs in the frozen recipe split
metrics.method: number of action verbs assigned to a valid core divided by all annotated action verbs; report unmapped/ambiguous separately and freeze tokenizer, lemmatization and language coverage.
metrics.notes: Do not compare directly to the 2025 paper's 76.5% until its corpus and cosine matching protocol are reproduced.

metrics.denominator: all predicted non-unmapped action groups
metrics.method: micro and macro precision against human-adjudicated gold labels on a frozen split.

metrics.denominator: all human-adjudicated gold action-group labels
metrics.method: micro and macro recall against human-adjudicated gold labels on a frozen split.

metrics.denominator: all gold-annotated action verbs
metrics.method: unmapped or intentionally ambiguous verbs divided by all annotated action verbs.

metrics.denominator: all proposed ontology mappings reviewed by humans
metrics.method: fraction of mappings changed or rejected during blinded adjudication.

metrics.denominator: all planning-only benchmark episodes
metrics.method: published Kitchen-R task completion and instruction-planning evaluator; retain failed plans in denominator.

metrics.denominator: all low-level policy episodes
metrics.method: published policy evaluator success and time limits, with failures retained.

metrics.denominator: all end-to-end integrated benchmark episodes
metrics.method: end-to-end planner plus control success on the same seeded episodes; do not impute perfect atomic execution.

metrics.denominator: all episodes with a declared recoverable perturbation or recoverable failure
metrics.method: fraction restored to a valid goal state without human takeover under frozen perturbation protocol.

metrics.denominator: all integrated benchmark episodes
metrics.method: episodes requiring human intervention divided by all episodes, including timeouts.

metrics.denominator: all successful and failed episodes
metrics.method: publish per-episode wall-clock/simulation time and summarize successful and failed episodes separately.

metrics.denominator: one completed cooking task or meal
metrics.method: weigh the edible output after a preregistered removal of non-edible matter; record rejected fraction and assessors separately.
metrics.notes: Do not infer food safety from visual or sensory acceptance.

metrics.denominator: one completed meal
metrics.method: count portions meeting frozen serving mass and acceptance rubric; record rejected portions separately.

metrics.denominator: all predicted action units
metrics.method: true positive grounded action units divided by all predicted action units, with action-span and group matching rules frozen.

metrics.denominator: all gold-annotated action units
metrics.method: true positive grounded action units divided by all gold action units on the same annotated split.

metrics.denominator: one standardized post-task cleaning cycle
metrics.method: measure elapsed active cleaning time from first cleaning action to a preregistered visual/residue endpoint; do not equate visual cleanliness with microbiological cleanliness.

metrics.denominator: one standardized cooking batch
metrics.method: weigh cooked output after fixed rest/drain protocol and before serving; retain initial mass and water addition.

metrics.denominator: all appliance/workcell trials for a defined task family
metrics.method: count trials with a preregistered permanent damage/failure event divided by all trials; document severity and repairability.

metrics.denominator: one task execution or complete meal, stated per run
metrics.method: integrate calibrated real-power measurements over the complete task/meal interval; record meter class, sampling rate, voltage and uncertainty.

metrics.denominator: total recovered processed mass
metrics.method: sieve or calibrated image-size assay; fines are particles below a preregistered lower size threshold. Freeze threshold and recovery procedure.

metrics.denominator: all dishes in a multi-dish meal
metrics.method: count dishes whose ready timestamp is after the preregistered serve time; never omit failed or incomplete dishes.

metrics.unit: mass fraction or protocol-specific moisture result
metrics.denominator: one sampled cooked batch with stated sampling locations
metrics.method: use a documented gravimetric or validated moisture-analyzer protocol; report method, sample preparation and instrument calibration.

metrics.denominator: one task run over a fixed measurement window
metrics.method: measure A-weighted equivalent sound level with a calibrated meter at a preregistered distance, orientation and background-noise condition.

metrics.denominator: total recovered product mass
metrics.method: weigh product outside preregistered geometry/size specification using blinded sieve or calibrated image classification.

metrics.denominator: one standardized cleaning cycle
metrics.method: count detachable parts that the prescribed cleaning process requires the operator to handle; freeze the part inventory by SKU/revision.

metrics.denominator: one standardized cleaning cycle
metrics.method: measure residue after fixed soil loading and cleaning protocol using a validated gravimetric or chemical assay; report detection limit.

metrics.denominator: one processing task
metrics.method: weigh recoverable material left on bowl, blade, disc, lid and accessories immediately after task under a fixed recovery protocol.

metrics.denominator: all cooking trials for a task/recipe
metrics.method: blinded assessors apply a preregistered visible-scorch and/or chemical endpoint; report both separately if both used.

metrics.denominator: all submitted recipe task graphs including rejected outputs
metrics.method: independent validation of ingredient references, action graph integrity, dependency DAG, resource requirements and temporal windows; retain parse/generation failures in denominator.

metrics.denominator: one processing task
metrics.method: measure maximum product temperature minus initial product temperature with calibrated probes at preregistered locations and timing.

metrics.denominator: one standardized batch sampled at fixed positions
metrics.method: measure product temperature at preregistered spatial positions after a fixed cooking endpoint; report mean, standard deviation and max-min range.

metrics.denominator: one batch with fixed sample count and geometry
metrics.method: use a calibrated texture analyzer or frozen blinded sensory rubric; report probe/geometry/protocol and do not conflate different assay units.

metrics.denominator: one processing task
metrics.method: recovered processed mass divided by active processing time; report setup, feeding and cleaning time separately.

metrics.denominator: one dish or dish-specific task
metrics.method: elapsed time from preregistered start event to dish meeting its blinded ready-to-serve endpoint.

metrics.denominator: one complete multi-dish meal
metrics.method: elapsed time from meal workflow start to all accepted dishes ready for service; unfinished/late dishes are failures, not censored.

metrics.denominator: total input mass for the task
metrics.method: mass of input remaining outside the target processing specification divided by starting input mass.

metrics.denominator: one task or complete meal, stated per run
metrics.method: time-motion study of active hands-on user effort, including setup, feeding, monitoring requiring presence, handling and cleaning; separate passive waiting.

metrics.denominator: one standardized cleaning or meal workflow
metrics.method: integrate calibrated water-meter readings for all in-scope operations; state included activities and sampling resolution.

metrics.denominator: total starting ingredient mass
metrics.method: (starting mass - recovered usable output mass) / starting mass; account for intentional peel/seed/bone removals separately.

metrics.denominator: all integrated episodes whose protocol requires environment restoration
metrics.method: episodes whose final scene digest and object placements satisfy the preregistered restoration predicate divided by all restoration-required episodes.
metrics.notes: Do not infer restoration from task success alone; compare final state to the declared target scene.

metrics.denominator: all low-level-control and integrated episodes
metrics.method: episodes with one or more simulator collision/contact events divided by all applicable episodes; also report counts and severity.
metrics.notes: Simulated collision incidence is not physical risk qualification.

metrics.denominator: all recovery attempts, with failed attempts retained and right-censored separately
metrics.method: time from perturbation/failure trigger to independently verified restoration of the affected subgoal; report successful recovery median and failed/censored count.

metrics.denominator: all verb instances for which the ontology abstains or marks unmapped
metrics.method: Correctly abstained ambiguous/unsupported verbs divided by all abstentions, scored against human-adjudicated labels.
metrics.notes: A low coverage system can obtain high precision by abstaining; report coverage and group recall alongside this metric.

metrics.denominator: all action verb occurrences in the frozen recipe corpus
metrics.method: Frequency-weighted fraction of verb occurrences mapped to a validated action core; report type-level unique-verb coverage separately.
metrics.notes: Must use fixed corpus, language normalization, tokenization and split. Not directly comparable to the 2025 paper until its full protocol is reproduced.

metrics.denominator: all mapped or abstained verb instances presented for review
metrics.method: Count adjudicator edits/rejections divided by verb instances, multiplied by 100.
metrics.notes: Blind reviewers to system identity; retain inter-annotator agreement and unresolved disagreements.

metrics.denominator: eligible end-to-end workflow trials with WAN/cloud unavailable and local manual mode available
metrics.method: disconnect WAN and disable cloud dependencies before the frozen run; count completed accepted workflows without remote service, camera or microphone divided by all eligible attempts; retain failures and exclusions
metrics.notes: Manual mode remains subject to all appliance-local interlocks; this is not permission to bypass a safety function.

metrics.denominator: eligible user takeover or override attempts in supported non-hazardous workflows
metrics.method: count overrides that transfer control to the user, expose current state and stop autonomous recommendations/actions without hidden restart, divided by all eligible attempts
metrics.notes: Never test override by defeating pressure, thermal, blade, motor or electrical protection.

metrics.denominator: eligible user takeover or override attempt
metrics.method: time from deliberate user override input to clearly indicated stable manual-control state; report median, p95 and failures

metrics.denominator: one declared user-serviceable non-safety module replacement
metrics.method: time from safe electrical isolation to completion of manufacturer-defined post-replacement functional check; report tools, operator class, steps and consumables
metrics.notes: Exclude pressure vessels, high-voltage assemblies and safety-critical parts unless separately qualified for the exact service procedure.

metrics.denominator: all completed declared module-service interventions
metrics.method: count interventions passing the exact manufacturer-defined post-service functional verification divided by all completed interventions; failed and inconclusive checks remain in denominator
metrics.notes: Functional verification is not independent safety certification.

metrics.denominator: accepted edible servings
metrics.method: meter preparation, cooking and cleaning water separately; sum only complete, boundary-matched terms and divide by accepted servings; preserve unknown terms and meter uncertainty

metrics.denominator: total weighed ingredient and process-liquid input mass
metrics.method: weigh accepted edible output, trim, rejects, residues, collected drainage/condensate and other declared outputs; include evaporation only when measured or bounded with disclosed uncertainty; compute absolute unaccounted mass divided by total input mass
metrics.notes: Unknown mass flows are not zero. Do not claim closure by omitting evaporation, drainage or cleaning residues.

metrics.denominator: calibrated measured wall-plug energy per frozen trial
metrics.method: freeze the model prediction before each run and calculate absolute(predicted minus measured) divided by measured energy; report distribution by workload, power/load class and held-out trial
metrics.notes: A model prediction is not measurement; do not train or tune on held-out evaluation trials.

metrics.denominator: all preregistered simulated disturbance episodes
metrics.method: count episodes where deterministic replanning reaches a valid schedule without temporal, resource, module-capability or power-envelope violations divided by all injected episodes; report abstentions, failures and latency separately
metrics.notes: Disturbances are injected in simulation only unless a separate physical safety case permits a specific test.

metrics.denominator: all simulated episodes with a fully observable set of applicable task-aware safety specifications
metrics.method: post-hoc evaluation of each episode against frozen task-specific temporal safety invariants; numerator requires every applicable spec to satisfy its threshold throughout the rollout; missing required signals are excluded from safe claims and reported separately
metrics.notes: Not native task success. An episode is safe only relative to the declared, valid, observable specification set.

metrics.denominator: all simulated episodes, with conditional-on-success rate additionally reported
metrics.method: count episodes that satisfy the native task success predicate but violate one or more active applicable safety specifications; report count/all episodes and count/native-success episodes
metrics.notes: Unsafe success is not accepted success and cannot be compensated by speed or energy.

metrics.denominator: all simulated episodes with at least one applicable safety specification
metrics.method: compute normalized worst violation depth per episode using frozen spec robustness thresholds; report distribution, p95 and worst case
metrics.notes: A rare severe violation cannot disappear in the mean.

metrics.denominator: all safety specifications declared applicable to an episode
metrics.method: count applicable specs whose required signals are present, valid and within sampling/quality requirements divided by all applicable specs; N/A requires a frozen task-aware reason
metrics.notes: Unavailable required signals are unknown, not safe and not N/A by default.

metrics.denominator: all preregistered simulated hazard-trigger episodes
metrics.method: count episodes where the controller reaches the declared safe stopped state within the task-specific time bound without violating another active spec divided by all trigger episodes
metrics.notes: Simulation only; physical emergency-stop and appliance-local protection require separate independent qualification.

metrics.denominator: all evaluated episodes across the official 50-task RoboCasa365 multi-task split, task-averaged with 18/16/16 split weighting
metrics.method: Reproduce the exact official RoboCasa365 release/evaluator and report the full 50-task score plus the three split scores; retain failed, timed-out and aborted episodes
metrics.notes: Current public 16 Nov 2026 leader: 0.856 overall. The benchmark is a simulated manipulation-policy result, not an end-to-end physical kitchen outcome.

metrics.denominator: all evaluated episodes on the 18 Atomic-Seen target tasks
metrics.method: Official RoboCasa365 Atomic-Seen split; same evaluator, horizons, initial-state distribution and episode accounting
metrics.notes: Current public leader: 0.911.

metrics.denominator: all evaluated episodes on the 16 Composite-Seen target tasks
metrics.method: Official RoboCasa365 Composite-Seen split; same evaluator, horizons, initial-state distribution and episode accounting
metrics.notes: Current public leader: 0.850.

metrics.denominator: all evaluated episodes on the 16 Composite-Unseen target tasks
metrics.method: Official RoboCasa365 Composite-Unseen split; tasks held out from pretraining; same evaluator and zero-shot task protocol
metrics.notes: Current public leader: 0.800. Unseen composite transfer is a non-compensatory reporting dimension.

metrics.denominator: all 100 full-length tasks in the official 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge evaluation set
metrics.method: Official average task success score using BDDL partial credit under the 2026 challenge rules; retain task-level scores, failures and evaluator version
metrics.notes: Public-set comparison lane only: the published ninth-place solution report discloses 0.446 Q for its public submission. Do not call this the 2026 champion/SOTA; the verified champion reports 0.683 Q on hidden test instances, tracked separately.

metrics.denominator: all evaluated episodes across the official 100-task BEHAVIOR-1K 2026 challenge set
metrics.method: Count tasks where all goal predicates are satisfied divided by all evaluated tasks; report beside BDDL Q and preserve incomplete episodes
metrics.notes: Public-set comparison lane only: the published ninth-place solution reports 0.273 full-task success. The verified champion's 0.482 is on hidden test instances and is tracked separately.

metrics.denominator: 100 official 2026 BEHAVIOR tasks evaluated on the organizer-held hidden instances (10 instances per task; 1,000 episodes total)
metrics.method: Use the official 2026 challenge evaluator and hidden-instance protocol; average BDDL goal-predicate partial credit per task and macro-average across all 100 tasks. Record per-task and per-instance values, evaluator version, embodiment, sensor suite and budget.
metrics.notes: Verified 2026 champion (The North Star / HiPhys-RSI) reports 0.683 Q on organizer-scored hidden instances. Do not compare with the 0.446 ninth-place public-set result as though they share an evaluation split.

metrics.denominator: all 1,000 official 2026 BEHAVIOR hidden-test rollouts (100 tasks × 10 instances)
metrics.method: Count only rollouts satisfying every goal predicate under the official evaluator; divide by all hidden-test rollouts, preserving timeouts, aborts and incomplete episodes.
metrics.notes: Verified 2026 champion reports 0.482 full-task success on hidden instances. Keep separate from BDDL partial-credit Q and from public-set results.

metrics.denominator: all episodes in the separately human-adjudicated intent-fidelity audit set
metrics.method: Independent blinded reviewers judge whether the final physical/simulated state fulfills the natural-language human intent, not only the benchmark's symbolic goal predicates; use a frozen task-specific rubric and preserve disagreement/adjudication records.
metrics.notes: Custom Luminous audit lane. The BEHAVIOR champion report documents examples where benchmark predicates can be satisfied without fully realizing the intended task; this metric is not part of official BEHAVIOR Q.

metrics.denominator: all episodes on a frozen set of kitchen layouts/environments excluded from policy training and adaptation
metrics.method: Luminous generalization extension using the official 50-task policy suite and locked, disjoint environment/layout IDs; no fine-tuning or environment-specific adaptation on the held-out set. Report each task split and environment separately.
metrics.notes: Custom environment-generalization lane. The current RoboCasa365 public leaderboard reports Atomic-Seen, Composite-Seen and Composite-Unseen task splits evaluated in pretraining kitchens; it does not supply a matched held-out-household-layout score.

metrics.denominator: all task states classified during the frozen disturbance suite
metrics.method: Count states labelled known when required independent observation/interlock evidence is missing, stale, contradictory or outside the declared freshness bound; report per disturbance family and worst case.
metrics.notes: False-known state is a critical failure, not an average-accuracy tradeoff.

metrics.denominator: all episodes in the frozen power/utility interruption and restoration suite
metrics.method: Count any automatic continuation or restart of pressure, thermal, blade or other safety-relevant operation without independently verified local-controller state and manufacturer-approved resume conditions.
metrics.notes: Hard negative-control metric; no automatic restart permission is introduced by this planner.

metrics.denominator: all injected events that make a previously known task state stale or unknown
metrics.method: Elapsed monotonic time from disturbance evidence arrival to the planner marking dependent task/material state unknown and blocking automatic continuation.
metrics.notes: Only a software detection-latency metric; not a physical sensor or safety reaction-time claim.

metrics.denominator: all injected events requiring manual handoff
metrics.method: Elapsed monotonic time from the planner's receipt of an unresolved disturbance to producing a human-readable manual handoff report.
metrics.notes: Does not measure human response time or prove accessibility.

metrics.denominator: all frozen simulated disturbance cases independently adjudicated feasible before evaluation
metrics.method: Count cases where the planner proposes a valid schedule/partial-meal alternative satisfying frozen constraints and preserving the original meal intent; compare with no-replan and fixed-rule baselines.
metrics.notes: Report infeasible cases separately; no post-hoc reclassification.

metrics.denominator: accepted edible output mass/servings achievable without the disturbance under the same initial inputs
metrics.method: Compare accepted output after disturbance against matched undisturbed reference using identical recipe, initial state and acceptance criteria; preserve quality and safety gates.
metrics.notes: Simulation estimates are not physical edible-yield results.

metrics.denominator: all preregistered eligible non-hazardous workflows tested with WAN and planning service unavailable
metrics.method: Count workflows that remain locally and manually operable without cloud, household network or planner service; do not bypass appliance protections.
metrics.notes: Manual operability must be tested physically before any product claim.

metrics.denominator: all replanned tasks and meal outputs after an injected disturbance
metrics.method: Count output/task records retaining a complete provenance link to original human intent, affected proposal/task revision, disturbance record and explicit human-approved partial/substitute decision.
metrics.notes: A replan must not silently redefine success.

metrics.denominator: all adversarial manifest/task combinations where at least one required capability, revision, resource or evidence field is absent, stale, mismatched or unsupported
metrics.method: Count candidates admitted despite a required blocker or unknown being present; evaluate against an independently adjudicated gold manifest/task suite.
metrics.notes: Critical false-admission metric; target zero on the frozen adversarial conformance suite.

metrics.denominator: all candidates containing stale, revoked or mismatched hardware, firmware, adapter or capability-manifest revisions
metrics.method: Count all incompatible revision candidates correctly rejected or made indeterminate; report block versus unknown classification separately.
metrics.notes: Every admission receipt must bind exact relevant revisions.

metrics.denominator: all predeclared task/module pairs in the held-out vendor capability-manifest conformance set
metrics.method: Count independently reviewable pairs that pass typed semantic compatibility for the same task-family contract; do not count a vendor device with missing evidence as compatible.
metrics.notes: Report by task family, vendor, hardware/firmware revision and reason for exclusions.

metrics.denominator: each new exact hardware/firmware module revision added to the conformance corpus
metrics.method: Measure engineer/lab hours from receipt of type-plate and source documents to a valid manifest, conformance report and reproducible admission fixture; include failed attempts.
metrics.notes: Physical onboarding effort requires time-study evidence; synthetic estimates are not measured.

metrics.denominator: all safety-relevant task/module states required by the frozen state-observability contract
metrics.method: Count states that can be independently observed with valid, fresh, revision-bound evidence; missing states remain unknown.
metrics.notes: Observability does not grant safety authority or prove sensor truth.

metrics.denominator: all simulated firmware/hardware revision changes that affect one or more declared capabilities
metrics.method: Count changes that invalidate dependent admission receipts and require a fresh exact-revision conformance result before reuse.
metrics.notes: No downstream receipt may silently survive a relevant capability revision change.

metrics.denominator: all consented participants × preregistered eligible task/configuration attempts
metrics.method: Count attempts meeting frozen task success criteria without unplanned human assistance; report per task and tested interaction/configuration, with withdrawals/missing observations visible.
metrics.notes: Human study metric; must not be represented by a simulator score.

metrics.denominator: all consented participant task attempts
metrics.method: Count attempts requiring unplanned assistance or takeover; distinguish planned caregiver assistance, requested assistance and system failure.
metrics.notes: Assistance is not automatically a failure; report its type and participant preference.

metrics.denominator: all blinded plan/status interpretation trials across known, unknown, blocked, manual-handoff and complete states
metrics.method: Participants interpret task state from the declared output modalities; score exact state and safe next action using a frozen rubric.
metrics.notes: Do not infer comprehension from click completion or voice-command success.

metrics.denominator: all eligible non-hazardous interrupted-task manual handoff trials
metrics.method: Count trials where participant can find, understand and complete the declared manual handoff/stop path without hidden restart or safety bypass.
metrics.notes: Hazardous physical operations remain subject to appliance-local instructions and interlocks.

metrics.denominator: all instrumented control, lid, fixture and connector actions in the physical test fixture
metrics.method: Measure peak and sustained force using a calibrated force gauge and frozen action protocol; report distribution and uncertainty by task/control.
metrics.notes: No universal accessible-force threshold is asserted by this manifest; interpretation requires relevant human-factors evidence.

metrics.denominator: all critical known/unknown/blocked/stop/complete states in the frozen interaction inventory
metrics.method: Count states with two independent communication modalities, including at least one non-audio modality, tested for correctness and availability.
metrics.notes: UI conformance coverage only; user comprehension is separately assayed.

metrics.denominator: all deterministic consent scopes and revocation scenarios in the privacy conformance suite
metrics.method: Count cases where revoked/expired/wrong-scope consent blocks subsequent private-data access/export and produces a non-sensitive audit receipt.
metrics.notes: Privacy behavior is not proved by a UI toggle; test the data boundary.

metrics.denominator: all consented participant task attempts
metrics.method: Count tasks voluntarily abandoned before task success; classify reason using participant choice without requiring personal or diagnostic disclosure.
metrics.notes: Preserve voluntary withdrawal without treating it as a negative personal outcome.

metrics.denominator: all adversarial price/cost cases where actual declared cost exceeds, or cannot be proved to be below, the household budget
metrics.method: Count cases incorrectly classified within budget when any required price, pack-size, utility tariff, tax/delivery component or accepted-serving denominator is missing, stale, mismatched or makes the known cost exceed budget.
metrics.notes: Hard false-positive metric; target zero on the frozen adversarial suite.

metrics.denominator: accepted edible servings under the frozen meal outcome and cost boundary
metrics.method: Sum all in-scope evidenced costs, including required pack purchase surplus and declared utility cost components, then divide by accepted servings; report components, currency, scope and uncertainty separately.
metrics.notes: A physical result requires actual receipt/price and outcome evidence. Currency and accounting boundary must be explicit.

metrics.denominator: all price observations used to claim current budget feasibility
metrics.method: Count price facts whose exact product/pack/market/currency scope is valid at the frozen proposal/decision time and within its declared validity window.
metrics.notes: A merchant listing is not a household receipt; source classes remain separate.

metrics.denominator: all matched proposals with complete proposal-time price facts and subsequent verified receipts
metrics.method: Compute absolute predicted-versus-receipt total cost difference divided by actual receipt cost under the same declared accounting boundary; report signed error and component-level causes.
metrics.notes: Matched household receipt evidence requires consent and local privacy protection.

metrics.denominator: all substitution proposals explicitly presented to a consenting household user
metrics.method: Count substitutions accepted by the user; separately report decline, no-response, preference conflict and replan burden. Never assume acceptance from model ranking.
metrics.notes: User choice remains authoritative; a declined substitute cannot be treated as a successful plan.

metrics.denominator: total in-scope acquired food cost for the declared meal
metrics.method: Calculate cost of acquired edible/packaged quantity not used by the meal, distinguishing usable household remainder from unavoidable unusable surplus and unknown remainder.
metrics.notes: Do not label usable remainder as waste; inventory stays local and is not silently decremented.

metrics.denominator: all adversarial cleaning cases where residue, component state, method evidence or exact revision is missing, stale or invalid
metrics.method: Count cases incorrectly labelled clean/qualified when one or more required residue/method/revision prerequisites are absent or contradicted.
metrics.notes: Hard negative-control metric; zero on frozen adversarial suite. Does not assert physical hygiene.

metrics.denominator: pre-clean residue quantity for each declared soil/component/sampling-location combination
metrics.method: Measure pre/post cleaning residual using the frozen validated assay and sampling plan; report absolute residual, removal fraction, detection limit and uncertainty by surface/soil family.
metrics.notes: Physical assay only; visual inspection is not an adequate substitute.

metrics.denominator: all validated allergen-source → cleaning-method → next-food test pairings with valid assays
metrics.method: Count assay-positive carryover tests divided by valid tests; separately report assay sensitivity/LOD/LOQ, invalid controls and indeterminate results.
metrics.notes: A zero positive rate does not establish universal allergen absence; scope is limited to tested analytes, methods and conditions.

metrics.denominator: all residue/allergen claims where an assay result is used for a declared acceptance threshold
metrics.method: Count assays whose validated detection/quantification capability is sufficient for the predeclared claim threshold and matrix/surface conditions.
metrics.notes: An assay negative above the relevant threshold is indeterminate for that claim.

metrics.denominator: one exact module/component cleaning event ending in a valid residue-assessed state
metrics.method: Measure all cleaning/rinse water within the frozen boundary and divide by completed module cleaning events; report failed/repeated cleaning separately.
metrics.notes: Does not equate lower water to better hygiene.

metrics.denominator: all food-contact modules/components entering declared storage after cleaning
metrics.method: Count modules meeting a frozen moisture/drainage/dry-storage observation protocol before storage; retain time since cleaning and measurement uncertainty.
metrics.notes: Dry-storage status is method- and component-specific.

metrics.denominator: all cases where the gold standard says a food-contact surface must be held from the next food task
metrics.method: Count unqualified/unknown surface cases correctly held from scheduling; separately report false holds and missed holds.
metrics.notes: Unknown or stale cleanability evidence cannot be assumed safe.

power_scheduler.claim_boundary: Power limits and demand profiles must be site- and appliance-specific. Synthetic fixtures are not household measurements; profile evidence and calibration remain explicit.

Three-stage scheduling: existing parallel earliest-gap, deterministic event-boundary power-aware staggering, then serial topological fallback. This is a heuristic and is not globally optimal.
